job.job_title: QA Automation Engineer GenAI, Storage & System Testing
job.job_description:
QA Automation Engineer GenAI, Storage System Testing
This role has been designed as Hybrid with an expectation that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
What You ll Do
Design and develop scalable automation frameworks using Python or Perl.
Build and enhance AI-driven QA solutions, including GenAI-based test generation, defect triage, and log analysis.
Develop and execute system-level tests to validate performance, reliability, and scalability of storage and OS environments.
Create tools for log parsing, data collection, and automated validation to support intelligent testing workflows.
Analyze system architecture and define efficient test strategies across storage, OS, and networking layers.
Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing.
Collaborate with development teams to identify, debug, and resolve defects early.
Drive innovation through AI-assisted testing and automation improvements.
What You Need to Bring
4 6 years of experience in QA automation, system testing, or storage testing.
Strong programming skills in Python or Perl.
Solid understanding of testing principles, debugging, and automation design.
Hands-on experience with Linux/Unix systems.
Familiarity with automation frameworks such as pytest or unittest.
Understanding of CI/CD tools like Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
Exposure to storage concepts (SAN/NAS, RAID, file systems) and system-level testing.
Basic knowledge of networking and distributed systems is a plus.
Experience or interest in Generative AI, LLMs, or AI-driven testing approaches.
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and ability to work collaboratively
Additional Skills:
Cloud Architectures, Cross Domain Knowledge, Design Thinking, Development Fundamentals, DevOps, Distributed Computing, Microservices Fluency, Full Stack Development, Security-First Mindset, Solutions Design, Testing Automation, User Experience (UX)
What We Can Offer You:
Health Wellbeing
We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
Personal Professional Development
We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
Unconditional Inclusion
We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
Lets Stay Connected:
Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.
